title: The LGTM Stack, Operated
prereqs: A kind cluster with RAM headroom — the stack is heavy
description: Run Grafana's LGTM stack, not just query it: deploy and operate Loki (logs), Grafana (dashboards & alerting), Tempo (traces), Mimir (metrics at scale) and Alloy / OpenTelemetry Collector on Kubernetes — multi-tenancy, object storage, retention, cardinality, LogQL/TraceQL/PromQL in anger, dashboards-as-code, and the cost/scale tradeoffs a Grafana-Labs SRE lives in. Complements Course 6 (which instruments your app); this one operates the platform.
